aboutHeading: 15 Years of Electrical Excellence in West Footscray
aboutText: With 15 years of dedicated electrical experience, Denki Electrical proudly serves West Footscray and Melbourne's western suburbs. We specialise in comprehensive rewires, mains upgrades, and smart lighting solutions for homes and businesses. Our friendly, communicative team ensures your project is on time, on budget, and tailored to your needs. From your initial quote to final testing, we keep you informed every step of the way.
servicesSubheading: Safe, reliable power for your property
servicesText: Denki Electrical provides a full range of residential and commercial electrical services across West Footscray and surrounding suburbs. From urgent repairs to full installations, our licensed team delivers safe, high-quality workmanship every time.

services.title: Complete Rewires
services.desc: Full house rewiring for safety and reliability in older West Footscray homes and renovations.

services.title: Mains & Switchboard Upgrades
services.desc: Upgrade your electrical mains and switchboard to meet current safety standards and demand.

services.title: Lighting Design & Installation
services.desc: Expert advice and installation for indoor, outdoor, and smart lighting systems to enhance your space.

services.title: Power Point & Circuit Installations
services.desc: Additional power points, dedicated circuits, and safe solutions for appliances and home offices.

services.title: Smoke Alarm Installation
services.desc: Compliant hard-wired smoke alarm installation and testing for complete home safety.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Prompt diagnosis and repair of electrical faults, outages, and safety hazards in your property.
